name: FleetPulse
tagline: A driver portal for freight shipments with a dispatch agent drivers can chat with — active shipment, dock-slot booking, exception reporting. Booking is two-phase, hold then confirm, and each step is an atomic Postgres function, so two drivers can never take the same slot. If the agent runtime is unreachable the portal still works.

name: Lead Intelligence System
tagline: Scores inbound leads and drafts outreach against a hybrid deterministic-semantic rubric, routing on a 2×2 of fit and intent. Batching and rate-limit recovery cut LLM API calls by 88%.

name: RAG Pipeline
tagline: Document QA over PDFs: tuned chunking, ChromaDB with HuggingFace embeddings, and an LLM re-ranking stage that beat baseline top-k retrieval.
